mouse.contactDefinition: Day contact is the low forward paw baseline. Rest contact is the midpoint of the curled body support baseline, including the resting tail.

hermit.contactDefinition: Day contact uses the support midpoint between the low front claws. Rest contact uses the low shell/toe support baseline at the shell centre.

tagbird.contactDefinition: Day and rest contact use the low forward toe/perch contact baseline. The claw extends down to that baseline while the body remains above it.

flight.contactDefinition: A shared virtual toe/perch baseline under the tucked feet. Torso and head remain registered while wings travel above and slightly below this virtual support plane.
